question: Should this PR establish the `dinkus-blocks` cascade layer as the compatibility contract for existing consumer overrides?
rationale: The change deliberately alters stylesheet precedence across every renderer, and the repository policy reserves merges for Bobby's explicit approval.

options.title: Approve the layer contract
options.body: Accept the documented unlayered-site override model as the supported compatibility behavior for existing consumers.

options.title: Require upgrade evidence first
options.body: Add an existing-consumer override fixture demonstrating the intended precedence before approving the new contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the layer contract
